contributions.statement: Unreviewed, auto-generated per-step acceptance criteria can mislead an agent rather than guide it.
contributions.evidence: §4.3 Table 2: the 'w/o RL Rubric' variant scores 72.44 vs 72.76 for plain ReAct, a 0.3-point single-run difference under an LLM judge, which is noise rather than evidence of harm.
relative_to: 2607.01980 LLM-generated Gherkin criteria miss negative scenarios
